text:
Maria: FYI running simulated onboard for 65B q4f16 on Dedicated H100 pools in APAC. p99 is 420ms vs SLA 250ms. Kernel A is current default.
Ajay: did you try kernel B (tiling + fused-attn)?
Maria: yeah — kernel B drops p99 to ~300ms but still over SLA. throughput slightly better. link: https://internal/bench/381234
BenchBot: [simulation summary]
```
region | gpu  | kernel | concurrency | p50  | p95  | p99
APAC   | H100 | A      | 4           | 120  | 260  | 420
APAC   | H100 | B      | 4           | 110  | 220  | 300
US     | A100 | B      | 4           | 100  | 190  | 240
```
Kevin: looks like APAC needs either lower concurrency per GPU or more GPUs. what's our target concurrency for Dedicated for a 65B workload? 3?
Sam: remember warmup and prefix/KV cache behavior — microbursts without warm cache blow the tail out. The sim used cold-start mix 25%.
Tia: ops-sim suggests autoscale headroom of ~35% to meet p99 under the 95th-percentile burst delta we saw. that implies reserved runway.
Ajay: pragmatic plan: reduce default concurrency to 3 for APAC H100 for the first-week rollout and add canary routing to US if latency > 300ms.
Maria: proposing rollout plan: +20% initial pool GPUs in APAC, default concurrency 3, autoscale threshold at 65% GPU util, fallback route to US on p99 > 300ms; run 24h sim and capture evals.
Kevin: +1. Also make kernel B default on H100 for this model, but keep kernel A toggle (fallback) for corner cases.
Sam: will update runbook and put alert: p99 > 300ms for >5m triggers on-call. will add dashboard slices by model+kernel+region.
Tia: small quality note — q4f16 quant shows a 0.4 relative BLEU regression on the internal eval set vs FP16. product flagged threshold is 1.0. we should gate rollback on quality too.
Maria: noted. rollout will include eval gating: if quality drop > 1.0 (relative) we rollback immediately. we'll run targeted evals during canary.
Ajay: owners? Ops rollout: @Sam. Model owner: @Maria. Kernel opt questions: @Kevin. I'll monitor the live evals and tail metrics.
Sam: I'll schedule canary tomorrow 10:00 PT, will post live links and ops-bot updates.
OpsBot: Canary rollout scheduled: 2026-03-21 10:00 PT. Will post deploy status to #eng-platform and create a short-lived shipping channel. :shipit:
Maria: Thanks all. I'll upload the sim artifacts + raw CSVs to the drive after 12:30 and tag the thread. Action items: @Sam update runbook and alerts, @Kevin provision the +20% GPUs, @Ajay monitor eval regressions and tail metrics.
Ajay: adding small follow-up — can we run a cheap probe in APAC at concurrency=2 for 2 hours to estimate cost vs latency tradeoff before we commit extra GPUs?
Kevin: yes, I can spin a probe pool. Will report cost delta.
Maria: perfect. closing for now — will reopen if sim changes. :thumbsup:
